newsitem.title: USA: Delaware House passes college savings proposal.
newsitem.headline: Delaware House passes college savings proposal.

text.p: Delaware's House of Representatives approved Gov. Tom Carper's plan to help families save to pay for college tuition.
The governor and Republican Rep. Bill Oberle unveiled the plan last week. It would set up a state-administered savings fund overseen by financial and educational experts.
All money put into the fund would be considered a tax deferred investment, and would benefit from lower tax rates when the money was withdrawn.

Another bill in the governor's college savings package is getting solid support in the Senate. It would use good performances on the state's new testing program as part of the criteria for the scholarship incentive program.
